title: CHAPTER 2 : BASIC CONCEPTS OF LOGIC
content:
ሰላም ሰላም! ውድ የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች፤ እንኳን ወደ Logic & Critical Thinking Chapter 2, Part 1 በሰላም መጣችሁ! ይህ ምዕራፍ የ Mid ፈተናችሁ የሚያተኩርበትና በአስተሳሰባችሁ ላይ አዎንታዊ ተፅዕኖ የሚፈጥር የኮርሱ ምርጡ ክፍል ነው። ዛሬ የምዕራፉን በጣም ወሳኝና መሠረታዊ ክፍል የሆነውን Lesson 1: Basic Concepts of Logic በጥልቀትና በፍፁም ግልጽነት እንማራለን። 👇👇👇


Lesson 1: Basic Concepts of Logic: Arguments, Premises and Conclusions

Lesson Overview ፡
• Logic is generally defined as a philosophical science that evaluates arguments. An argument is a systematic combination of one or more statements, which are claimed to provide a logical support or evidence (i.e., premise(s)) to another single statement which is claimed to follow logically from the alleged evidence (i.e., conclusion).
👉 ሎጂክ ማለት ሙግቶችን (Arguments) የምንመዝንበትና የምንመረምርበት ሳይንሳዊ መንገድ ነው። ሙግት (Argument) ደግሞ የማስረጃ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች (Premises) ተያይዘው ለአንድ ዋና ማጠቃለያ (Conclusion) ድጋፍ የሚሰጡበት አደረጃጀት ነው።
• The primary aim of logic is to develop a system of methods and principles that we may use as criteria for evaluating the arguments of others and as guides in constructing arguments of our own.
👉 የሎጂክ ዋና ዓላማ የሌሎችን ሙግት የምንመዝንበትንና የራሳችንን ትክክለኛ ሙግት የምንገነባበትን መርሆችና ዘዴዎች ማዘጋጀት ነው።


1.1 What is the Meaning of Logic?

Etymology and Definitions ፡
• The word logic comes from the Greek word "logos", which means sentence, discourse, reason, truth, and rule.
👉 ሎጂክ የሚለው ቃል "Logos" ከሚለው የግሪክ ቃል የተገኘ ሲሆን ትርጉሙም ንግግር፣ ምክንያት፣ እውነት ወይም ህግ ማለት ነው።
• Logic in its broader meaning is the science which evaluates arguments and the study of correct reasoning.
👉 በሰፊው ትርጉሙ ሎጂክ የትክክለኛ አስተሳሰብና የምክንያታዊነት ሳይንስ ነው።

Key Definitions of Logic / የሎጂክ መሠረታዊ ብይኖች፡
• Logic is a science that evaluates arguments.
👉 ሎጂክ ሙግቶችን የሚመዝን ሳይንስ ነው።
• Logic is the study of methods for evaluating arguments—more precisely, whether premises adequately support or provide good evidence for conclusions.
👉 መነሻ ሃሳቦች (Premises) ለማጠቃለያው (Conclusion) በቂ ማስረጃ መስጠታቸውን የምንመረምርበት ዘዴ ነው።
• Logic helps to develop principles used as criteria for evaluating others' arguments and constructing our own.
👉 የራሳችንን አሳማኝ ሙግት ለመስራትና የሌሎችን ለመገምገም እንደ መስፈርት ያገለግላል።
• Logic is the attempt to codify the rules of rational thought.
👉 ምክንያታዊ የአስተሳሰብ ህጎችን በስርዓት የሚያደራጅ ዘርፍ ነው።


1.2 What is the Benefit of Studying Logic?

Philosophical Quote ፡
• "Logic sharpens and refines our natural gifts to think, reason and argue." (C. S. Layman)
👉 "ሎጂክ ተፈጥሯዊ የማሰብ፣ የመሞገትና የመመራመር ብቃታችንን ይስላል፤ ያጎለብታልም።" (ሲ. ኤስ. ሌይማን)

Major Benefits of Logic / የሎጂክ ዋና ጥቅሞች፡
• Helps to develop skills needed to construct sound and fallacy-free arguments and evaluate others' arguments.
👉 ከስህተት (Fallacy) ነፃ የሆኑ አሳማኝ ሞገቶችን እንድንሰራና የሌሎችን እንድንመዝን ይረዳል።
• Provides a fundamental defense against prejudiced and uncivilized attitudes that threaten a civilized and democratic society.
👉 ከጭፍን ጥላቻና ያልተሰበኩ አመለካከቶች እንደ መከላከያ ሆኖ ያገለግላል።
• Helps us to distinguish good arguments from bad arguments.
👉 ጥሩና መጥፎ ሞገቶችን ለይተን እንድናውቅ ይረዳናል።
• Enables us to identify common logical errors in reasoning and confusions caused by misuse of language.
👉 በቋንቋ አጠቃቀምና በአስተሳሰብ ውስጥ የሚፈጠሩ የተለመዱ የሎጂክ ስህተቶችን ለመለየት ይረዳል።
• Enables us to disclose ill-conceived political policies and distinguish rational from irrational.
👉 የተሳሳቱ ፖሊሲዎችንና ምክንያታዊ ያልሆኑ ሃሳቦችን እንድንነቅስ ያደርገናል።


1.3 What is an Argument?

Technical Definition ፡
• An argument is a group of statements, one or more of which (the premise) are claimed to provide support for, or reason to believe, one of the other (the conclusion).
👉 ሞገት (Argument) ማለት አንድ ወይም ከዚያ በላይ የሆኑ መነሻ ሃሳቦች (Premises) ለአንዱ ማጠቃለያ ሃሳብ (Conclusion) ማስረጃ ወይም ድጋፍ የሚሰጡበት የዓረፍተ ነገሮች ስብስብ ነው።
• In logic, an argument does NOT mean a mere verbal fight or dispute with someone.
👉 በሎጂክ ትርጉም ሞገት ማለት ከሰው ጋር የሚደረግ የቃላት ጭቅጭቅ ወይም ፀብ አይደለም! 🤫

Core Component 1: What is a Statement (Proposition)?
• A statement is a declarative sentence that has a truth-value of either true or false.
👉 ሴንተንስ (Sentence) 'Statement' ሊባል የሚችለው መግለጫ (Declarative) ሆኖ **True** (እውነት) ወይም **False** (ሐሰት) የሚል የትክክለኛነት ዋጋ (Truth-value) ሲኖረው ብቻ ነው።
• Logicians use 'proposition' and 'statement' interchangeably. Proposition refers to the meaning or information content of a statement.
👉 'Proposition' እና 'Statement' በሎጂክ ውስጥ ተመሳሳይ ትርጉም አላቸው።

Examples of Statements / የስታትመንት ምሳሌዎች፡
• Dr. Abiy Ahmed is the current Prime Minister of Ethiopia. (True)
• Mekelle is the capital city of Tigray Region. (True)
• Ethiopia was colonized by Germany. (False)
👉 ሦስቱም መግለጫዎች 'True' ወይም 'False' ተብለው ሊፈረጁ ስለሚችሉ **Statements** ናቸው።

Sentences that are NOT Statements / ስታትመንት ያልሆኑ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች፡
• Questions: Would you close the window?
• Proposals: Let us study together.
• Exclamations: Right on!
• Suggestions: I suggest that you read philosophy texts.
• Commands: Give me your ID Card, Now!
👉 ጥያቄዎች፣ ትእዛዞች፣ አስተያየቶችና አጋኖዎች True ወይም False ሊባሉ ስለማይችሉ **Statements አይደሉም**፤ ስለዚህ ለሞገት መስሪያነት አይሆንም!

💡 Exam Hint / Common Pitfalls :
• ፈተና ላይ "Which of the following is a statement?" ተብላችሁ ከተጠየቃችሁ፣ መግለጫ (Declarative) የሆነውንና True/False ብላችሁ መመለስ የምትችሉትን ብቻ መረጡ! ጥያቄ (?)፣ ትእዛዝ (!) ወይም ጥያቄ አቅራቢ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች በሙሉ Statement አይደሉም!


1.4 Components of an Argument: Premises and Conclusion

Core Structure ፡
• An argument is a group statement which contains **at least one premise** and **one and only one conclusion**.
👉 በማንኛውም ሞገት ውስጥ **ቢያንስ አንድ ወይም ከዚያ በላይ Premise** ሊኖር ይችላል፤ ነገር ግን **አንድና አንድ Conclusion ብቻ** ነው የሚኖረው!

Component
Definition
ማብራሪያ
Premise (P)
Statement setting forth reason or evidence.
ለማጠቃለያው ማስረጃ ወይም ምክንያት የሚያቀርብ ሃሳብ።
Conclusion (C)
The claim that the argument is trying to establish.
በማስረጃው ተደግፎ ሊረጋገጥ የተፈለገው ዋና ማጠቃለያ።

Examples of Arguments / የሞገት ምሳሌዎች፡

Example 1 (Good Argument):
• P1: All Ethiopians are Africans.
• P2: Tsionawit is Ethiopian.
• C: Therefore, Tsionawit is African.
👉 መነሻ ሃሳቦቹ ለማጠቃለያው ሙሉ በሙሉ አስተማማኝ ማስረጃ ስለሚሰጡ ጥሩ (Good) argument ይባላል።

Example 2 (Bad Argument):
• P1: Some Africans are black.
• P2: Zelalem is an African.
• C: Therefore, Zelalem is black.
👉 ምንም እንኳን ዓረፍተ ነገሮቹ እውነት ቢሆኑም፣ P1 እና P2 ለC በቂ ማስረጃ ስለማይሰጡ መጥፎ (Bad) argument ነው፤ ግን አሁንም Argument ይባላል።


1.5 Techniques of Identifying Premises and Conclusion

Technique 1: Indicator Words (አመላካች ቃላት)

A. Conclusion Indicators (የማጠቃለያ አመላካቾች) ፡
• Words that indicate the statement following them is the conclusion.
👉 ከእነዚህ ቃላት በኋላ የሚመጣው ዓረፍተ ነገር ሁልጊዜ Conclusion ይሆናል።
• Therefore, Wherefore, Accordingly, Provided that, It must be that, We may conclude, Entails that, Hence, It shows that, Whence, Thus, Consequently, We may infer, It implies that, As a result, So, It follows that.

B. Premise Indicators (የመነሻ ሃሳብ አመላካቾች) ፡
• Words that indicate the statement following them is a premise.
👉 ከእነዚህ ቃላት በኋላ የሚመጣው ዓረፍተ ነገር ሁልጊዜ Premise ይሆናል።
• Since, As indicated by, Because, Owing to, Seeing that, Given that, As, For, In that, May be inferred from, Inasmuch as, For the reason that.

💡 Special Indicator Trick: "For this reason" vs "For the reason that"
• "For the reason that" is a PREMISE indicator! (ከእሱ ቀጥሎ ያለው Premise ነው)
• "For this reason" comes between premise and conclusion! Statement BEFORE "for this reason" is PREMISE; statement AFTER "for this reason" is CONCLUSION!
👉 "For this reason" መሃል ላይ ሲገባ፦ ከእሱ በፊት ያለው Premise ሲሆን፣ ከእሱ በኋላ ያለው ደግሞ Conclusion ነው! እንዳትሸወዱ! Argument ተሰጧችሁ Premises እና Conclusion አውጡ ስለምትባሉ Indicatorሮችን በደንብ ያዙ🎯

Technique 2: Arguments Without Indicator Words (አመላካች ቃል የሌላቸው ሞገቶች)
• When there are no indicator words, ask yourself:
1. What single statement is claimed (implicitly) to follow from the others?
2. What is the arguer trying to prove?
3. What is the main point in the passage?
👉 ተናጋሪው ወይም ጸሐፊው ሊያስረዳንና ሊያሳምነን የፈለገው ዋናው ነጥብ ምንድን ነው? ብላችሁ ጠይቁ፤ መልሱ Conclusion ይሆናል! የቀሩት ደግሞ Premises ይሆናሉ።

Examples without Indicator Words / አመላካች ቃል የሌላቸው ሞገቶች ምሳሌ፡

Example 1:
"The medical profession is highly demanding. It requires long years of intensive study and extreme commitment. Doctors often work under high pressure for long hours."
• Analysis: በዚህ ምንባብ ውስጥ ምንም አይነት indicator word (Because, Therefore...) የለም። ነገር ግን ጸሐፊው ሊያሳምነን የፈለገው ዋና ሃሳብ "The medical profession is highly demanding" የሚለውን ነው። የቀሩት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች የህክምና ሙያ ለምን አጋጣሚና ፈታኝ እንደሆነ ማስረጃ ያቀርባሉ።
• Conclusion: The medical profession is highly demanding.
• Premises: 1) It requires long years of intensive study and extreme commitment. 2) Doctors often work under high pressure for long hours.

Example 2:
"Excessive sugar consumption increases the risk of tooth decay. It also leads to weight gain and heart problems. You should reduce your daily intake of sugary foods."
• Analysis: ዋናው መደምደሚያ ወይም ተናጋሪው ሊመክረን የፈለገው ነጥብ የመጨረሻው ዓረፍተ ነገር ነው። የመጀመሪያዎቹ ሁለት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ለምክሩ ምክንያት (Premises) ናቸው።
• Conclusion: You should reduce your daily intake of sugary foods.
• Premises: 1) Excessive sugar consumption increases the risk of tooth decay. 2) It leads to weight gain and heart problems.

Non-Argumentative Elements in Passages / በሞገት ውስጥ የማይካተቱ አባባሎች፡
• Passages may contain statements that are neither premises nor conclusions (e.g., passing comments or background information). They should be excluded from the argument context.
👉 በምንባብ ውስጥ ለዋናው ማጠቃለያ ድጋፍ የማይሰጡ፣ እንዲሁ ለማለፊያ የተነገሩ (Passing comments) አባባሎች ከPremise ወይም Conclusion ውጪ ይደረጋሉ።

Concept of Inference (ኢንፈረንስ) ፡
• In a narrower sense, inference means the reasoning process expressed by the argument.
• Broadly, it refers to the argument itself or the inferential link between premises and conclusion.
👉 ኢንፈረንስ ማለት በመነሻ ሃሳብና በማጠቃለያው መካከል ያለው የመሰተዋወቅ/የማስረጃ ፍሰት ሂደት ነው።


Exam-Style Questions

1. Which one of the following sentences can be classified as a statement in logic?
A) Turn off the lights before you leave the class.
B) How many chapters are included in the logic module?
C) Hawassa is the capital city of Sidama Region.
D) I suggest that we study together for the exam.
Answer: C
Explanation: Option C is a declarative sentence that has a truth-value (True). A is a command, B is a question, and D is a suggestion—none of which have a truth-value.

2. In the argument: "You should avoid any form of cheating on exams because cheating on exams is punishable by the Senate Legislation," the statement "cheating on exams is punishable by the Senate Legislation" is:
A) The Conclusion
B) The Premise
C) A Passing Comment
D) An Exclamation
Answer: B
Explanation: The statement follows the premise indicator word "because", making it the premise that supports the claim not to cheat.

3. An argument can contain:
A) Multiple premises and multiple conclusions.
B) At least one premise and only one conclusion.
C) Only one premise and multiple conclusions.
D) No premises and one conclusion.
Answer: B
Explanation: By definition, an argument must contain at least one or more premises, but it can contain one and only one conclusion.
